title: Ridgeline Warranty Coverage Transfer Schedule: Transferability, Limits, Fees and Caps for a Later Owner
content:
When the registered owner sells the home, Warranty Coverage can pass to the buyer only under plans this schedule marks transferable. For plans that are not transferable, the transfer count, window, fee and later-owner caps are all zero.

## Schedule

| Plan | Transferable | Transfers allowed over the life of the coverage | Request window (calendar days after the home sale closing date) | Transfer fee (USD) | Cap on every product term for a later owner (years from the original coverage start) | Cap on labor and workmanship terms for a later owner (years from the original coverage start) | Glass breakage carries over to a later owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Limited Warranty | no | 0 | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 | no |
| Ridgeline Limited Plus Warranty | no | 0 | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 | no |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Limited Warranty | yes | 1 | 30 | 95.00 | 10 | 1 | no |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Plus Warranty | yes | 1 | 60 | 75.00 | 15 | 2 | no |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Premier Warranty | yes | 1 | 60 | 50.00 | 20 | 5 | yes |
| Ridgeline Owner-to-Owner Lifetime Warranty | yes | 2 | 90 | 0.00 | 50 | 10 | yes |

## Column notes

- The transfer fee is the plan's fee to transfer the registration, charged to the requesting seller.
- Both caps are counted from the original coverage start date, not from the date of the sale or the transfer.
- The product-term cap applies to every product component term; the labor cap applies to the labor and workmanship terms.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

Under the Ridgeline Lifetime Plus Warranty, a later owner's lifetime frame term is capped at 15 years from the original coverage start date and the labor term at 2 years from that same date; if the home was sold 4 years after coverage began, the labor term for the buyer has already ended.
